about: Mod style sections of the public gallery, after the vanilla section. Add one entry per style. mod_env and res_env name the environment variables that hold that style's scratch mod and result folder. Generated images are shown for a style, with a few credited reference images from the mod (W5-9, widened 2026-11-08): refs_env names the folder of reference PNGs, one sub-folder per family.

styles.title: TNO style
styles.credit: The New Order: Last Days of Europe, by the TNO Team
styles.intro: The families with their own look in *The New Order: Last Days of Europe*. Each has the generated examples and, above them, a few reference images from the mod itself, credited to it and its team and shown only so readers can compare. The art belongs to its authors. Families the mod draws in the vanilla style are only in the vanilla section.
